mapper.select: SELECT S.SERVICE AS "service" ,S.CALLS AS "calls" ,S.FAILS AS "fails" ,S.AVG_MS AS "avgMs" ,S.P95_MS AS "p95Ms" ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM S.LAST_AT) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "lastAt" ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM F.CALLED_AT) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "lastFailAt" ,F.STATUS_CODE AS "lastFailStatus" ,F.ERROR_MSG AS "lastFailError" ,F.ACTION AS "lastFailAction" FROM ( SELECT SERVICE ,COUNT(*) AS CALLS ,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE SUCCESS_YN = 'N') AS FAILS ,ROUND(AVG(ELAPSED_MS))::INT AS AVG_MS ,ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ELAPSED_MS))::INT AS P95_MS ,MAX(CALLED_AT) AS LAST_AT FROM T_API_CALL_LOG WHERE CALLED_AT >= #{since} GROUP BY SERVICE ) S LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT CALLED_AT, STATUS_CODE, ERROR_MSG, ACTION FROM T_API_CALL_LOG WHERE 1=1 AND SERVICE = S.SERVICE AND SUCCESS_YN = 'N' AND CALLED_AT >= #{since} ORDER BY CALLED_AT DESC LIMIT 1 ) F ON TRUE ORDER BY S.FAILS DESC, S.CALLS DESC

SELECT TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('hour', CALLED_AT AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul'), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24') AS "hour" ,SERVICE AS "service" ,COUNT(*) AS "calls" ,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE SUCCESS_YN = 'N') AS "fails" FROM T_API_CALL_LOG WHERE CALLED_AT >= #{since} GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT SERVICE AS "service" ,ACTION AS "action" ,COUNT(*) AS "calls" ,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE SUCCESS_YN = 'N') AS "fails" ,ROUND(AVG(ELAPSED_MS))::INT AS "avgMs" ,MAX(ELAPSED_MS) AS "maxMs" FROM T_API_CALL_LOG WHERE CALLED_AT >= #{since} GROUP BY SERVICE, ACTION ORDER BY 4 DESC, 3 DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT ID AS "id" ,SERVICE AS "service" ,ACTION AS "action" ,STATUS_CODE AS "status" ,ELAPSED_MS AS "elapsedMs" ,ERROR_MSG AS "error" ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CALLED_AT) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "at" FROM T_API_CALL_LOG WHERE SUCCESS_YN = 'N' ORDER BY CALLED_AT DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM T_API_CALL_LOG WHERE CALLED_AT < NOW() - MAKE_INTERVAL(DAYS => #{keepDays})
